content.text:
Last quarter's net revenue after refunds was **€8,743,316.38**.

- **Metric:** net_merchandise_value v1.0.0 (certified)
- **Time range:** 1 July 2026 to 30 September 2026 (last quarter, worked out as of 14 November 2026)

I used net merchandise value because "after refunds" matches its definition: the value of paid orders minus refunds. If you meant what the marketplace itself earned, that is commission_revenue (commission on paid orders minus commission refunded to dealers), which is also certified. I can run that for the same quarter instead.

Refunds are attributed to the original order's date, so this figure can fall if late refunds come in.
